verdict.rationale: Certification and ruggedness are fair questions for a hardware security key, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions FIPS 140 validation, Common Criteria certification, or documented water or crush resistance. The pack only covers protocols, SDKs, the CLI and community comments about firmware and USB port wear, none of which address certified models or durability ratings.

support.subject: As an IT admin, certified models exist for regulated environments — FIPS 140 validated or Common Criteria certified — with documented durability (water/crush resistance)
